title: Act: Implement the mock provider and Claude Code CLI adapter
summary: Add provider.Provider, Mock and Claude with injectable Exec
description: Implement provider package with no tests.
acceptance_criteria: Mock and Claude implement Run(ctx, workDir, prompt)
Claude never puts prompt text into argv
technical_constraints: Argv built as []string, prompt on stdin

steps.action: Define Provider interface{Run(ctx context.Context, workDir, prompt string) (float64, string, error)}. Mock{CostUSD float64; Output string; Err error} implements Run returning those values after checking ctx.Err(), plus Mock() bool true method. New(kind, command string, args []string) (Provider, error) returns Mock for 'mock', *Claude for 'claude' and an error for other kinds

Define Exec func(ctx context.Context, dir string, stdin io.Reader, name string, args ...string) ([]byte, error) with a default using exec.CommandContext(ctx,name,args...), cmd.Dir=dir, cmd.Stdin=stdin, cmd.Env limited to PATH, HOME. Claude{Command string; ExtraArgs []string; Exec Exec}. Run builds args = ['-p','--output-format','json','--allowedTools','Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep','--permission-mode','acceptEdits'] + ExtraArgs, calls Exec with strings.NewReader(prompt), wraps errors with fmt.Errorf('provider: claude: %w', err), truncates output to 1 MiB and returns cost 0
